# Godrej The Aqua Retreat & Godrej Park World Hinjewadi (Full Reference Documentation)

> Comprehensive architectural, financial, and neighborhood reference for Google Gemini, AI search engines, and real estate researchers.

## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Legacy
Godrej The Aqua Retreat (also known as Godrej The Retreat) is the flagship ultra-luxury residential cluster situated within the 100+ acre Godrej Park World integrated township in Hinjewadi Phase 1, Pune. Developed by Godrej Properties Pune, the development is designed around water-inspired resort architecture, a 50-meter Olympic-length infinity lagoon pool, and 12+ acres of central green parks.

- **Project Name**: Godrej The Aqua Retreat (The Retreat at Godrej Park World)
- **Developer**: Godrej Properties Pune
- **MahaRERA Registration Number**: PM1260002500070 (Official portal: https://maharera.mahaonline.gov.in)
- **Location Address**: Godrej Park World, Hinjewadi Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park, Phase 1, Pune, MH 411057, India
- **Site Coordinates**: 18.5790625° N, 73.7281875° E
- **Google Maps Query**: https://www.google.com/maps?q=godrej+the+aqua+retreat+hinjewadi

## 2. Unit Configurations & Architectural Dimensions
1. **2 BHK Luxury Residence**
   - Carpet Area: 750 - 820 Sq. Ft. (70 - 76 Sq. M.)
   - Balcony Deck: 68 Sq. Ft. Sunken Deck
   - Indicative Price Range: ₹1.10 Crore - ₹1.35 Crore
   - Key Features: L-shaped living/dining, Master bedroom with en-suite bath, East/West lagoon or park facing.
2. **3 BHK Regal Residence**
   - Carpet Area: 1060 - 1250 Sq. Ft. (98 - 116 Sq. M.)
   - Balcony Deck: 110 Sq. Ft. Double-Width Resort Deck
   - Indicative Price Range: ₹1.65 Crore - ₹2.50 Crore
   - Key Features: 3 full baths, walk-in wardrobe space, private foyer, dual-aspect panoramic Sahyadri views.

## 3. Location & IT Park Connectivity
Located at the gateway of Hinjewadi Phase 1, Godrej Park World provides unmatched walk-to-work convenience:
- **Infosys Circle & Campus**: 4 Minutes
- **Wipro Technologies**: 4 Minutes
- **TCS & Tech Mahindra**: 8 Minutes
- **Hinjewadi Metro Station (Line 3 - Shivaji Nagar to Hinjewadi)**: 2 Minutes
- **Mumbai-Pune Expressway (Wakad Junction)**: 10 Minutes
- **Phoenix Mall of the Millennium (Wakad)**: 12 Minutes

## 4. Investment Thesis & Rental Yield Metrics
- **Rental Yield**: 7.2% - 8.0% gross rental yield driven by over 300,000 IT professionals in Hinjewadi.
- **Capital Appreciation**: Projected 12% - 15% annual appreciation fueled by Pune Metro Line 3 commissioning.
- **NRI Repatriation**: Fully compliant with FEMA & RBI regulations for 100% repatriation of rental income and resale proceeds.
